source.name: Footy Headlines: Norway 2026 World Cup Home & Away Kits Released
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. Match photos of the shirt (World Cup, June-July 2026) show no advertising on front, back, sleeves or shorts; NFF lists Nike as 'utstyrsleverandør' (equipment supplier) to all national teams.
source.quote: This is the Norway 2026 home jersey, made by Nike

source.name: KIWI: På banen i over 30 år
source.note: KIWI's own site says the men's national team wears the KIWI logo ('landslagsdrakta'); the match shirt itself carries no sponsor (World Cup match photos on footyheadlines.com), so the logo sits on team training/presentation wear.
source.quote: I dag bærer David Møller Wolfe KIWI-logoen på landslagsdrakta

summary: Norway's national-team home shirt carries no commercial sponsors; Nike makes the kit. KIWI (grocery chain, NFF hovedsponsor with BAMA from 2026) is worn on team training/presentation wear, not on the match shirt.
